sql.join_count_distinct:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM public.orders AS o JOIN public.order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.created_at >= %s::timestamp AND o.created_at < %s::timestamp
sql.exists_count:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM public.orders AS o
WHERE o.created_at >= %s::timestamp AND o.created_at < %s::timestamp AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items AS i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id)
sql.join_order_ids:
SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id
FROM public.orders AS o JOIN public.order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.created_at >= %s::timestamp AND o.created_at < %s::timestamp
sql.exists_order_ids:
SELECT o.order_id
FROM public.orders AS o
WHERE o.created_at >= %s::timestamp AND o.created_at < %s::timestamp AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items AS i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id)
